name: Default
shortDescription: Workflow orchestration platform to author, schedule and monitor Python DAGs, running the LocalExecutor with PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in as the admin user with the generated AIRFLOW_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. Changing it later in the environment does not update an existing user.
Airflow starts with no DAGs. Copy your DAG files into the apache-airflow-dags volume (mounted at /opt/airflow/dags), or set AIRFLOW_LOAD_EXAMPLES to true to load the bundled examples.
